node.title: Re^3: Portably unit testing scripts
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I might artificially limit the platforms my distribution will install on

Yeah, I like portability myself, and I had the same worry when I started releasing CPAN modules, but experience has shown me that portability is possible. And even if you release a module and it initially [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Badge-Simple%200.01|fails] on a bunch of CPAN Testers, it's possible to bring it [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Badge-Simple%200.04|back] to 100%. As you probably saw, the [mod://Shell::Tools] tests (which my example code above is based on) [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Shell-Tools|pass] on Cygwin, Darwin (Mac OS X), FreeBSD, GNU/kFreeBSD, Haiku, Linux, MSWin32, NetBSD, OpenBSD, and Solaris.
